title: Encoding a register call
statement: For any Boolean word $x$, output word $u$, state $s$, natural number $i$, decider index, and positive and negative successor states, the virtual input formed by calling the whole-input decider on the input segment $x$ and the single register containing the binary representation of $i$ is the self-delimiting encoding $\langle x,\operatorname{bits}(i)\rangle$.
hypotheses_covered: Arbitrary positive and negative successor states
